# Cue animations

Lottie animations drawn by the visual cue effects (`src/app/components/game/cue-overlay/`).

**Where they come from:** every file here is generated by `tools/cue-animations/generate.mjs`
(`npm run cue-animations`). They are built from code in this repository, not downloaded, so they
are covered by the project's own license. Don't edit the JSON by hand: change the generator and
run it again.

**Conventions:** 100 composition pixels are one card unit (the smaller side of the card or panel
the effect lands on). Fills and strokes named `@accent`, `@c0`, `@c1` or `@c2` are palette slots
that the client recolors to the effect's look; other colors are fixed. The files use no
expressions, images or fonts, so they play in lottie-web's light canvas build.

**Adding one:** add a builder to `generate.mjs`, run it, and add the name to `CUE_ANIMATIONS` in
`cue-animations.ts`.
